C1132.title: Major Dubai Heist Used AI Voice Cloning
C1132.summary: In early 2020, the UAE saw a major transfer fraud case involving AI voice cloning. Investigators said attackers used synthetic voice to impersonate a company executive or authorized person and induced personnel to execute a large fund transfer. The case is commonly cited as a warning example of AI voice cloning being abused in business email compromise, transfer fraud, and executive impersonation attacks.

references.title: Fraudsters Cloned Company Director's Voice In $35 Million Heist - Forbes
